pages.heading: Laviathan
pages.body: Nether lava lakes. Passive, but an injured one may dive. Equip both a Straddlite Saddle and Tack for controlled travel with up to four passengers. Water

pages.heading: Laviathan (cont.)
pages.body: turns it into an obsidian form. Breed with Crimson Mosquito Larva and heal with Magma Cream. Carry your own heat protection.
